messages:
rachael: FYI planning to unpin runtime v4.1.0 for cohort 'realtime-small' in tonight's 00:30-02:30 UTC window. Fixes a batching ordering bug that impacts tail latency on short prompts. Any SDK compatibility constraints we should enforce? :wave:

diego: Heads-up: theres still a handful of hosts with SDK 3.0.0-beta which previously hit an API mismatch. We should fail preflight unless SDK >= 3.0.1.

matt: Ops suggestion: gate deploybot with an explicit sdk-guard and add a lightweight runtime+sdk handshake check as part of canary boot. Canary plan:
- 00:40 deploy to 2 canary hosts (us-west) at 0.5% traffic
- 01:00 if green bump to 15%
- 01:20 full cohort roll
Rollback triggers: error-rate >1.2x baseline for 5m OR P95 token-latency delta >300ms for 10m.

rachael: Good. Also request that deploybot auto-scan for any hosts running the old shim and mark them as "needs-manual-review" rather than attempting to patch. We had one sticky host previously.

deploybot: [auto] scheduled job id: unpin-1758888888. Preflight checks added: `sdk-guard >=3.0.1`, `handshake-check`, `canary-smoke`. Will post run updates here.

diego: I'll push a quick validation script to the release branch that enumerates SDK versions and fails CI if any host reports <=3.0.0.

matt: Also add kv-cache warmup in the canary step (script in ops/runbooks/kv-warmup). Cold-starts artificially inflate tail latency.

rachael: Please include an explicit note in release notes about the handshake-check behavior and the "needs-manual-review" label so support knows why some hosts may be excluded.

obs-bot: Baseline snapshot created: https://internal/obs/dashboards/realtime-small/baseline-2024-09-14. Alert ids: rt-small-latency, rt-small-err-rate.

deploybot: [auto] Reminder: if the canary aborts, an incident stub will be created and oncall will be paged. Configured to post a one-line summary here + link to incident.

diego: ack (validation script + CI check)

matt: ack (canary/runbook/kv-warmup)

rachael: ack (release notes + support heads-up). Ready to mark "ready for window" after staging dry-run completes tonight at 21:00 PT.
